applicabilityBasis.summary: srUSDe represents a senior ERC-4626 yield tranche over sUSDe. Its exchange-rate value accrues strategy yield and redemption returns USDe or sUSDe at that exchange rate; the reviewed materials establish no fixed fiat-value redemption obligation.

genius.notes: Assessment applies to srUSDe, not to the USDe underlying token or the Ethena issuer. Interface terms name Frontera Labs, Inc. as interface operator, which is insufficient to assign it as a legal srUSDe issuer. No issuerEntity is asserted. MiCA and GENIUS wrapper scope are determined from the token mechanics, without claiming a legally registered fund or a blanket exemption from other crypto-asset laws.
